- Start the perfect day with our personalized daily planner. Prepare your notes and to-do list so nothing can surprise you during the day.

GUIDED JOURNALS

Whether you're a journaling pro or new to the practice, stoic offers a welcoming space with guided journals and prompts to inspire reflection and cultivate the habit. If writing is not your cup of tea, you can also journal with voice notes and pictures/videos of your day.

Choose from topics in productivity, happiness, gratitude, self-discovery, stress & anxiety, relationships, therapy, and much more. Stoic also has a lot of templates to help you with a variety of situations like preparing for a therapy session, CBT-based thought dumps, dream journals, etc.

Journaling serves as a therapeutic tool for clearing the mind, expressing thoughts, setting goals, and practicing gratitude, fostering emotional release and self-reflection.


MENTAL HEALTH TOOLS

• Practice gratitude - discover how many things you have in your life that you should be grateful for and journal about them.

• Meditation - an unguided session to help you meditate with background sounds and timed chimes.

• Breathing - deep calm and box breathing exercises.

• Quotes and Affirmations - read and save your favorite inspiring quotes from stoic philosophers, Lao Tzu, The Holy Bible, and Gautama Buddha.

• Fear Setting - a way of overcoming hard decisions in life introduced by Tim Ferriss. It will help you be less afraid of taking action.
